## Note

We are not authorized to publicly release the whole dataset used during the current study concerning safety-critical issues. Nonetheless, the processed example samples are available in the `train`, `dev`, and `test` directories.

The environmental maps, buildings, obstacles, and related geographic data used in the study are not provided because of data-security and access constraints. Users must prepare environmental data that match their own trajectory dataset, create the local `obstacle` directory, and adjust the corresponding paths and loading definitions in `optDir/opt_DROP.json` and `dataloader.py` before running the model.

## Guidance of example data

Each `*.txt` file contains one trajectory sample with 45 consecutive points. Each line records one point, and the nine fields are separated by `|`. A complete example is provided below:

The nine fields are defined as follows:

1. `timestamp`: date and time of the trajectory point;
2. `uav_id`: identifier of the UAV;
3. `longitude`: longitude of the UAV position;
4. `latitude`: latitude of the UAV position;
5. `altitude`: altitude of the UAV position;
6. `velocity_x`: velocity component in the first coordinate direction;
7. `velocity_y`: velocity component in the second coordinate direction;
8. `velocity_z`: vertical velocity component; and
9. `speed`: magnitude of the three-dimensional velocity vector.
